text:
Maya Lopez: Planning to push autoscale policy + GPU pool config change tonight 22:30 PST. Main changes: min_nodes 4->6, max_burst 20->24, autoscale smoothing 60s->45s. Target: dedicated-gpu-pool-us-west. Need: who is deploying, who runs smoke tests, rollback readiness. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4821 @Tom Hsu can you take owner? :eyes:

Tom Hsu: I can own deploy. I'll be on-call during the window. PR looks good, small note on variable naming but non-blocking. I'll run terraform apply + the rollout script. Leaving a note in the runbook.

Anil Rao: Quick Q — are we touching slice eviction thresholds in this change? That could affect warm pool behaviour and evictions.

Maya Lopez: Not in this push — only autoscaler params and burst cap. Keeping eviction thresholds unchanged. We'll do a single-slice canary (slice-a).

Jess Patel: Recommend canary on slice-a for 30m and check tail-latency + GPU OOMs. I can own the smoke: run 10k token-level requests against the canary variant, measure p99 and error rate.

Kyle Morgan: I'll prep the smoke job and dashboard links. Will standby for rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2024-10-12T22:30:00Z -> target: dedicated-gpu-pool-us-west -> executor: Tom Hsu. Prechecks required: capacity_headroom >= 15%, k8s nodes Ready, CI: green.

Tom Hsu: Preflight checklist I'll run at 21:45 PST: 1) capacity headroom check 2) kube nodes Ready 3) ci green 4) alerting endpoints healthy. Post-deploy: quick smoke at +5m and extended at +30m.

Jess Patel: Smoke commands (runbook snippet):
```
# smoke test
python infra/tools/smoke_run.py --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-us-west --concurrency 50 --duration 300
# collect p99
curl http://dash/reports?job=smoke | jq '.p99'
```

Anil Rao: Rollback criteria proposal: if p99 latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR any GPU OOMs reported. Agree?

Maya Lopez: Rollback plan: revert terraform commit, scale min back to 4, force-drain nodes added by the change, restart autoscaler, and restore previous autoscale params. Tom will initiate. Also open #incidents if rollback occurs.

Tom Hsu: Got it. I'll post a short summary in #eng-releases when done and tag the people. Ping me at 22:15 PST if any last-minute holds.

Kyle Morgan: I'll push the dashboard links and smoke job output into this thread as soon as smoke completes. :thumbsup:

Jess Patel: I'll monitor GPU metrics and look for OOM traces and memory spikes. :eyes:

Maya Lopez: Timeline recap:
- 21:45 PST preflight checks
- 22:30 PST deploy
- 22:35 PST quick smoke (+5m)
- 23:05 PST extended smoke and go/no-go decision
If anyone cannot make the window, say now.

Tom Hsu: All good from me. :party_parrot:

Anil Rao: Available.

deploy-bot: Deploy executed by Tom Hsu at 2024-10-12T22:30:12Z (simulated message).
